svg.text: Real MNIST embeddings and learned class geometry
Real MNIST training · digits 1–4 · 3D embeddings · seed 42 · 10 epochs · Adam 0.001
Projected 3D proxy positions · six inter-proxy edges
Each pair is measured in the original 3D embedding space, not in the 2D projection above.
Source: independent MNIST C4 trained runs provided by the author; proxy vectors from embeddings.npz (seed 42).
